programmes.d: A woman seeks the doctor's help when her husband makes a shocking confession.
A husband's alarming confessions.
Madisen, 15, says she wants desperately for a place to belong and has made terrible choices in an attempt to do just that: she says she has already joined a gang, gotten pregnant and hit a teacher.
Families of previous guests return: one with an amazing transformation and the other to face a dramatic confrontation.
Mothers on the verge of committing child abuse ask the doctor for help.
Meet the ordinary women who fear that they will hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage; Dr Phil answers their pleas of help with advice on how to stay in control.
Pamela says her husband abandoned her and their two teen sons for a massage therapist, causing one of their boys to commit suicide; the ex-husband and his sister counter with their own accusations.
Parents of two toddlers who died mysteriously, three months apart, are offered the opportunity to take lie-detector tests to clear their names.
Young women share their experiences with abusive, controlling or obsessive boyfriends.
Teen parents face off.
A look at what happens when an unhealthy relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart; Geisel says her 18-year-old daughter is boyfriend-obsessed and is damaging her promising future.
A woman says her 19-year-old daughter has fallen for a "bad boy," and she worries about her safety.
High-school students with two children.
Two mothers say they do not see eye-to-eye with their daughters about the boys they date.

Teen Corryn has become so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that she calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move; the teens' parents want an end to the relationship.
A couple come face to face with the man they believe murdered their daughter and learn the results of his polygraph test.

Tiffany's relationship with her child's father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises; after doing research midway through their relationship, Tiffany uncovered Erik's lies and put a stop to their wedding plans.
Erik's ex-girlfriends Torri and Courtney and ex-wife Martha each have different stories to share about his deceitful behavior.

Karen and Jim say their adult son is financially dependent upon them, has assaulted them, has served time behind bars, and refuses to move out of their home; he says they should be doing more to help him; Jon Taffer ("Bar Rescue") offers advice.
Jon Taffer ("Bar Rescue") offers advice to Karen and Jim and their abusive, overly dependent adult son, Kyle, who gives many excuses why he cannot move out of their home.
A man's wife and three children disappeared 15 years ago, leaving only a cryptic note behind.
A man reunites with his three children, whose mother abducted them more than 15 years ago.

Funeral escort Jeremy says he's being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison; Dr. Phil takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge.
Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Jeremy, a funeral escort who is being accused of impersonating a police officer and could face up to 85 years in prison.
The doctor puts three newly engaged couples to the test with his Premarital Boot Camp.

Engaged couples go through tests in the second premarital boot-camp that involve jumping through hoops together, long nights with lifelike infant dolls, surprise in-law visits, and temptation from others.
In the final episode of the premarital boot camp series, the couples try to break the tie in a "newlywed game" and win a dream wedding and honeymoon; seven questions to ask a partner before marrying.
Discussing what happened to America's Mayor; Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Rudy Giuliani in part two of their one-on-one interview.
Dr. Phil talks to the family of missing mom Julie Ann Gonzalez.
The husband of missing Texas woman Julie Ann Gonzalez talks about what he thinks happened to her.
Shemida says she has been diagnosed with more than 70 health conditions, but her family members say she is fabricating some of them.
Family members say Shemida's 70-plus diagnoses are tearing their family apart.
